1
00:00:09,070 --> 00:00:13,470
The third bowl tasted like rot.
I couldn't feel my hands anymore.

2
00:00:13,471 --> 00:00:15,807
The wolf bead had
already reached my chest.

3
00:00:15,831 --> 00:00:18,757
Lucian stood at the dend of
the bed and watched me go.

4
00:00:18,758 --> 00:00:21,790
Seven pups, whole high-ranking blood.
That's enough.

5
00:00:21,791 --> 00:00:24,270
I tried to speak. Nothing came out.

6
00:00:26,110 --> 00:00:28,030
You were never the one I wanted Vivienne.

7
00:00:29,230 --> 00:00:30,430
His voice didn't waver.

8
00:00:30,869 --> 00:00:35,790
You threw yourself at me.
I let it happen. That's all this ever was.

9
00:00:35,791 --> 00:00:38,830
I wanted to scream.
I wanted to tear him apart.

10
00:00:39,070 --> 00:00:40,670
But my body was already gone.

11
00:00:41,870 --> 00:00:43,230
You've served your purpose.

12
00:00:45,380 --> 00:00:46,820
He set the empty bowl down.

13
00:00:47,460 --> 00:00:48,420
Rest now.

14
00:00:48,421 --> 00:00:51,060
My heartbeat slowed. Then nothing.

15
00:00:52,580 --> 00:00:56,740
I opened my eyes. In my mother's
sitting room at Coldwell Manor.

16
00:00:59,390 --> 00:01:00,390
I came back.

17
00:01:01,765 --> 00:01:05,390
I pressed my hands flat
against my thighs and breathed.

18
00:01:05,391 --> 00:01:08,270
My mother was holding a
contract across the room.

19
00:01:08,271 --> 00:01:12,430
A mating bond contract, sealed
with the Blood Moon Pack crest.

20
00:01:12,431 --> 00:01:13,550
The name line was blank.

21
00:01:14,510 --> 00:01:17,870
The Velice's heir sent this
earlier this morning, Vivienne.

22
00:01:17,871 --> 00:01:19,470
Is it you he's asking for?

23
00:01:19,471 --> 00:01:23,470
Lucian sat across from her.
Same face. Same steady eyes.

24
00:01:23,471 --> 00:01:24,831
Like none of it had ever happened.

25
00:01:26,190 --> 00:01:28,190
I can marry Vivienne. I don't mind.

26
00:01:28,191 --> 00:01:30,910
I don't mind. Seven years. Seven children.

27
00:01:30,911 --> 00:01:32,510
Three bowls of wolf's babe.

28
00:01:32,511 --> 00:01:33,511
No.

29
00:01:34,190 --> 00:01:35,190
Silence.

30
00:01:35,430 --> 00:01:39,470
Viviana.
You've wanted this since you were 12.

31
00:01:41,390 --> 00:01:42,990
I was a kid. I didn't know any better.

32
00:01:42,991 --> 00:01:46,590
Lucian looked at me.
That calm, unerisval stare.

33
00:01:46,591 --> 00:01:49,230
I used to think meant he
was hiding something tender.

34
00:01:49,231 --> 00:01:50,231
Now I knew better.

35
00:01:51,699 --> 00:01:54,830
I also have someone.
He'll be here soon with his own contract.

36
00:01:55,569 --> 00:01:57,310
My mother's head snapped toward Aria.

37
00:01:57,870 --> 00:02:00,670
Aria had been quiet in
the corner this whole time.

38
00:02:00,671 --> 00:02:02,030
Now she shook her head hard.

39
00:02:02,830 --> 00:02:04,350
Same. I'm not available either.

40
00:02:04,750 --> 00:02:07,950
My mother turned back
to Lucian with a tight smile.

41
00:02:07,951 --> 00:02:13,810
I'm so sorry. It seems both my
daughters have prior commitments.

42
00:02:15,840 --> 00:02:16,880
Perhaps another pack?

43
00:02:17,520 --> 00:02:19,760
No. Lucian stood.

44
00:02:19,761 --> 00:02:23,200
The Alpha Aura rolled off
him slow and deliberate,

45
00:02:23,201 --> 00:02:25,200
pressing into every
corner of the room.

46
00:02:26,470 --> 00:02:29,040
The woman I marry comes
from the Coldwild family.

47
00:02:29,041 --> 00:02:31,440
His voice left no room for argument.

48
00:02:31,441 --> 00:02:32,720
That's not changing.

49
00:02:32,721 --> 00:02:35,440
He picked up the contract
and dropped it on the table.

50
00:02:36,390 --> 00:02:38,720
The sound cut through
the silence like a blade.

51
00:02:39,790 --> 00:02:43,520
You have three days. Decide who it is.

52
00:02:43,521 --> 00:02:44,640
Nobody moved.

53
00:02:44,641 --> 00:02:45,680
If you can't choose.

54
00:02:47,200 --> 00:02:48,400
He straightened his jacket.

55
00:02:50,700 --> 00:02:52,380
I'll take it to the Alpha King.

56
00:02:52,381 --> 00:02:57,780
One word from him and it
becomes a royal be a choice after that.

57
00:02:59,140 --> 00:03:00,820
He walked out without looking back.

58
00:03:01,380 --> 00:03:04,417
The door hadn't finished
closing before Aria

59
00:03:04,467 --> 00:03:06,580
grabbed my wrist and
pulled me down the hall.

60
00:03:09,455 --> 00:03:12,580
She shut us into my bedroom and
pressed her back against the door.

61
00:03:13,460 --> 00:03:14,500
Her face was white.

62
00:03:15,195 --> 00:03:18,020
I'll tell you something, but you
have to promise not to feel guilty.

63
00:03:18,070 --> 00:03:19,700
She said, I went still.

64
00:03:20,980 --> 00:03:22,980
Aria, promise me first.

65
00:03:24,234 --> 00:03:26,260
Something cold settled in my chest.

66
00:03:27,250 --> 00:03:28,250
I promise.

67
00:03:28,454 --> 00:03:30,260
She didn't look at me when she spoke.

68
00:03:31,414 --> 00:03:32,900
In another life.

69
00:03:32,901 --> 00:03:35,700
She said quietly, you gave me the contract.

70
00:03:36,180 --> 00:03:38,180
You told me Lucian loved me.

71
00:03:38,181 --> 00:03:40,180
You stepped aside.

72
00:03:40,181 --> 00:03:42,180
I couldn't breathe.

73
00:03:42,181 --> 00:03:44,180
He didn't love me.

74
00:03:44,230 --> 00:03:46,180
Her voice was flat, controlled.

75
00:03:46,181 --> 00:03:48,180
He kept me locked in a room.

76
00:03:48,181 --> 00:03:54,700
He said the only thing I was
good for was my Moon Veal voice.

77
00:03:54,701 --> 00:03:56,700
He made me sing for him every night.

78
00:03:58,700 --> 00:04:00,700
She paused.

79
00:04:03,630 --> 00:04:11,630
She finally looked at me.

80
00:04:11,631 --> 00:04:13,630
Her eyes were dry. That was somehow worse.

81
00:04:13,631 --> 00:04:15,630
He had my limbs
severed so I couldn't shift.

82
00:04:15,631 --> 00:04:20,670
He took my eyes.

83
00:04:20,671 --> 00:04:24,670
He left me my voice because that
was the only part of me he wanted.

84
00:04:25,860 --> 00:04:33,860
I made it back because
a servant broke the lock.

85
00:04:33,861 --> 00:04:35,860
I didn't last two months after that.

86
00:04:35,861 --> 00:04:37,860
I crossed the room and
pulled her into a hug.

87
00:04:37,861 --> 00:04:39,860
She went stiff for a second.

88
00:04:39,861 --> 00:04:41,860
Then her arms came up and held on.

89
00:04:41,861 --> 00:04:43,860
We stayed like that for a long moment.

90
00:04:43,861 --> 00:04:45,860
I pulled back, looked at her seriously.

91
00:04:45,861 --> 00:04:47,860
I have something to tell you too.

92
00:04:47,861 --> 00:04:49,860
I told her about
everything I'd been through.

93
00:04:49,861 --> 00:04:51,860
Including that I had been reborn too.

94
00:04:51,861 --> 00:04:55,860
Arya's expression turned
puzzled after learning the truth.

95
00:04:55,861 --> 00:04:57,860
So what do we do?

96
00:04:57,861 --> 00:05:01,870
We tell mom.

97
00:05:01,871 --> 00:05:07,740
Everything.

98
00:05:07,741 --> 00:05:09,740
My mother didn't speak while we talked.

99
00:05:09,741 --> 00:05:11,740
She sat very still with her
hands folded in her lap.

100
00:05:11,741 --> 00:05:15,740
When I got to the part about the
wolf bait, her knuckles went white.

101
00:05:15,741 --> 00:05:19,740
When Arya described
what Lucien had done to her,

102
00:05:19,915 --> 00:05:23,740
my mother pressed one hand over her
mouth and didn't move it for a long time.

103
00:05:23,741 --> 00:05:25,740
When we finished, the room was silent.

104
00:05:25,741 --> 00:05:29,740
Then she pulled both of us
toward her and held on hard.

105
00:05:29,741 --> 00:05:31,740
She was shaking.

106
00:05:31,741 --> 00:05:33,740
My girls.

107
00:05:33,741 --> 00:05:35,740
She said, just that.

108
00:05:35,741 --> 00:05:37,740
We sat there for a moment.

109
00:05:38,040 --> 00:05:39,740
Then she pulled back and wiped her face.

110
00:05:40,690 --> 00:05:41,740
So who does he actually want?

111
00:05:41,741 --> 00:05:43,740
Her voice was steady again.

112
00:05:43,741 --> 00:05:45,740
Why cold well?

113
00:05:45,790 --> 00:05:47,740
Why only cold well?

114
00:05:47,741 --> 00:05:51,090
I shook my head.

115
00:05:51,091 --> 00:05:53,090
I died too fast.

116
00:05:53,091 --> 00:05:55,090
I never heard the name.

117
00:05:55,091 --> 00:05:57,090
She looked at Arya.

118
00:05:57,091 --> 00:05:59,090
He never told me anything.

119
00:05:59,091 --> 00:06:01,090
Not once.

120
00:06:01,091 --> 00:06:03,090
My mother stood up.

121
00:06:03,091 --> 00:06:05,090
Straightened her jacket.

122
00:06:05,265 --> 00:06:07,090
That look came onto her face.

123
00:06:07,240 --> 00:06:09,090
The one that meant she'd
already decided something.

124
00:06:09,091 --> 00:06:14,580
She picked up her phone.

125
00:06:14,581 --> 00:06:16,580
I'll make some calls.

126
00:06:16,780 --> 00:06:21,920
Find someone willing and
available before that deadline hits.

127
00:06:21,921 --> 00:06:23,920
She pointed at Arya.

128
00:06:23,921 --> 00:06:25,920
You go through the manner.

129
00:06:25,921 --> 00:06:29,920
Every woman on
staff, every visitor log,

130
00:06:29,921 --> 00:06:31,920
anyone connected to
Lucian in the last five years.

131
00:06:31,921 --> 00:06:33,920
Arya nodded.

132
00:06:34,395 --> 00:06:35,920
My mother turned to me last.

133
00:06:35,921 --> 00:06:39,920
And you know him best, so
you're going to Blood Moon Manor.

134
00:06:39,921 --> 00:06:41,920
I know.

135
00:06:41,921 --> 00:06:43,920
I'm already thinking about
where he hides things.

136
00:06:43,921 --> 00:06:45,920
My mother looked at us both.

137
00:06:45,945 --> 00:06:47,920
Three days. Let's move.

138
00:06:48,445 --> 00:06:49,920
Blood Moon Manor was
exactly as I remembered it.

139
00:06:49,921 --> 00:06:55,200
Same long driveway, same
iron gates, same guard at

140
00:06:55,201 --> 00:06:57,920
the door that waved me
through without question.

141
00:06:57,921 --> 00:07:01,920
Because in this life, Lucian
and I were still childhood friends.

142
00:07:01,921 --> 00:07:03,920
That was the one advantage I had.

143
00:07:03,921 --> 00:07:05,920
I walked straight to the study.

144
00:07:05,921 --> 00:07:07,920
He was painting when
I pushed the door open.

145
00:07:08,270 --> 00:07:09,920
No knock.

146
00:07:09,921 --> 00:07:11,920
I didn't give him the courtesy.

147
00:07:11,921 --> 00:07:14,657
Lucian sat at his desk
with a brush in his hand,

148
00:07:14,658 --> 00:07:17,920
working on a canvas
propped against the wall.

149
00:07:17,921 --> 00:07:21,920
A woman, no face, white dress,
hair loose, head slightly turned.

150
00:07:21,921 --> 00:07:23,920
He didn't look up.

151
00:07:23,921 --> 00:07:25,920
You'd come.

152
00:07:25,921 --> 00:07:27,920
You paint a lot of these.

153
00:07:28,345 --> 00:07:29,920
I do.

154
00:07:29,921 --> 00:07:31,920
I crossed the room and stood behind him.

155
00:07:31,921 --> 00:07:33,920
The figure's posture was relaxed.

156
00:07:33,921 --> 00:07:35,920
One hand rested at her side.

157
00:07:35,921 --> 00:07:41,920
Her head tilted just slightly to the right,
like she was listening for something.

158
00:07:41,921 --> 00:07:43,920
And there, on the right side of her neck,

159
00:07:44,195 --> 00:07:47,920
just below the
jaw, a small mole.

160
00:07:47,921 --> 00:07:49,920
He used to be perfect.

161
00:07:49,921 --> 00:07:51,920
That was the problem.

162
00:07:51,921 --> 00:07:53,920
He'd said the same thing.

163
00:07:54,420 --> 00:07:55,920
It's you.

164
00:07:55,921 --> 00:07:57,920
It's always you.

165
00:07:57,921 --> 00:07:59,920
And I'd believed him.

166
00:07:59,921 --> 00:08:04,860
Every single time.

167
00:08:04,861 --> 00:08:06,860
Lucian, I kept my voice flat.

168
00:08:06,861 --> 00:08:08,860
I said, I don't have a mod on my neck.

169
00:08:08,861 --> 00:08:10,860
The brush stopped.

170
00:08:10,861 --> 00:08:12,860
His spine went rigid, just for a second.

171
00:08:12,861 --> 00:08:14,860
But I saw it.

172
00:08:15,260 --> 00:08:16,860
He set the brush down
and turned to face me.

173
00:08:16,861 --> 00:08:18,860
Easy smile, steady eyes.

174
00:08:18,861 --> 00:08:20,860
That's not a mole.

175
00:08:20,861 --> 00:08:24,397
He said, he smudged it.

176
00:08:24,398 --> 00:08:24,860
The ink slipped.

177
00:08:24,861 --> 00:08:26,860
Right. I held his graze.

178
00:08:26,861 --> 00:08:28,860
Of course it did.

179
00:08:28,861 --> 00:08:30,860
He leaned back in his
chair, completely relaxed.

180
00:08:30,861 --> 00:08:34,860
Vivian, you know me better
than anyone, don't you?

181
00:08:34,861 --> 00:08:36,860
I looked at the painting one more time.

182
00:08:36,861 --> 00:08:38,860
The mole was precise.

183
00:08:38,861 --> 00:08:40,860
Clean edged.

184
00:08:40,861 --> 00:08:42,860
No ink bleeding into the surrounding lines.

185
00:08:42,861 --> 00:08:46,860
A painter like
Lucian didn't slip.

186
00:08:46,861 --> 00:08:48,860
Lucian stared at me for a long moment.

187
00:08:48,861 --> 00:08:50,860
Do you really want to know who she is?

188
00:08:50,861 --> 00:08:52,860
I held my breath.

189
00:08:52,861 --> 00:08:54,860
He held my eyes.

190
00:08:54,861 --> 00:08:56,860
And for a second I thought
he might actually say it.

191
00:08:56,861 --> 00:08:58,860
But then he smiled.

192
00:08:58,861 --> 00:09:00,860
Slow and soft.

193
00:09:00,861 --> 00:09:02,860
It's you.

194
00:09:02,861 --> 00:09:04,860
It's always been you.

195
00:09:04,861 --> 00:09:06,860
He stood and walked toward me.

196
00:09:06,861 --> 00:09:08,860
Slow.

197
00:09:08,861 --> 00:09:10,860
Steady.

198
00:09:10,861 --> 00:09:12,860
Like he had all the time in the world.

199
00:09:12,861 --> 00:09:14,860
The ink slipped.

200
00:09:14,861 --> 00:09:19,140
That's all.

201
00:09:19,141 --> 00:09:21,140
He stopped in front of me.

202
00:09:21,141 --> 00:09:23,140
Everything we've been through.

203
00:09:23,141 --> 00:09:25,140
Have I ever given you a
real reason not to trust me?

204
00:09:25,141 --> 00:09:29,140
And the worst part was
I had to think about it.

205
00:09:29,739 --> 00:09:31,140
Because he hadn't.

206
00:09:31,189 --> 00:09:33,140
Not visibly.

207
00:09:33,239 --> 00:09:35,140
Not in any way I could have pointed to.

208
00:09:35,189 --> 00:09:39,140
He used to take the blame when we
were kids so I wouldn't get in trouble.

209
00:09:39,141 --> 00:09:41,140
He stayed up all night tutoring
me when I skipped training.

210
00:09:41,141 --> 00:09:43,140
He quietly learned the Luna rulebook

211
00:09:43,141 --> 00:09:45,140
just so I wouldn't embarrass
myself in front of other packs.

212
00:09:45,141 --> 00:09:49,140
For a long time I would
have done anything for him.

213
00:09:49,141 --> 00:09:53,140
For a long time that
was the problem.

214
00:09:53,141 --> 00:09:55,140
He saw me hesitate.

215
00:09:55,141 --> 00:09:57,140
He moved closer.

216
00:09:57,141 --> 00:09:59,140
You and Arya have been competing for years.

217
00:09:59,141 --> 00:10:01,140
I left the name blank to protect her.

218
00:10:01,141 --> 00:10:03,140
She's your sister.

219
00:10:03,141 --> 00:10:07,140
I thought if you accepted first
it'd be easier for her to let go.

220
00:10:07,141 --> 00:10:09,140
He searched my face.

221
00:10:09,141 --> 00:10:11,140
I didn't think you'd say no.

222
00:10:11,141 --> 00:10:13,140
I didn't think you'd take it as rejection.

223
00:10:13,141 --> 00:10:15,140
Everything he said landed perfectly.

224
00:10:15,141 --> 00:10:17,140
Perfectly timed.

225
00:10:17,141 --> 00:10:19,140
He reached out and took my hand.

226
00:10:19,141 --> 00:10:20,140
Gentle.

227
00:10:20,141 --> 00:10:22,140
Like I was something worth keeping.

228
00:10:22,141 --> 00:10:25,140
Three days from now I'll
come to Coldwell Manor myself.

229
00:10:25,141 --> 00:10:27,140
No contract games.

230
00:10:27,141 --> 00:10:29,140
No confusion.

231
00:10:29,141 --> 00:10:31,140
Just me.

232
00:10:31,141 --> 00:10:33,140
Asking for you.

233
00:10:33,141 --> 00:10:35,140
My throat tightened.

234
00:10:35,141 --> 00:10:37,140
Not because I believed him.

235
00:10:37,141 --> 00:10:39,140
Because I used to.

236
00:10:39,141 --> 00:10:43,140
Because there was a
version of me not so long ago

237
00:10:43,141 --> 00:10:45,140
who would have cried with
relief hearing these exact words.

238
00:10:45,141 --> 00:10:47,140
I missed her a little.

239
00:10:47,141 --> 00:10:49,140
But that version of me was dead.

240
00:10:49,141 --> 00:10:53,140
He'd killed her himself
with three bowls of Wolf Bab.

241
00:10:53,141 --> 00:10:57,140
I let the silence hang just
long enough to be convincing.

242
00:10:57,141 --> 00:11:01,140
Then I softened my shoulders and
looked up at him through my lashes.

243
00:11:01,239 --> 00:11:03,140
One more chance.

244
00:11:03,141 --> 00:11:05,140
I said quietly.

245
00:11:05,141 --> 00:11:07,140
He exhaled long and slow.

246
00:11:07,539 --> 00:11:09,140
Thank you.

247
00:11:09,141 --> 00:11:11,140
No formal proposal though.

248
00:11:11,141 --> 00:11:13,140
I kept my voice soft.

249
00:11:13,141 --> 00:11:15,140
We'll keep it simple.

250
00:11:15,141 --> 00:11:17,140
He nodded.

251
00:11:17,141 --> 00:11:21,140
That warm, open, completely
convincing smile still on his face.

252
00:11:21,141 --> 00:11:23,140
And I'll make it up to you.

253
00:11:23,141 --> 00:11:25,140
Every morning after we're mated.

254
00:11:25,141 --> 00:11:27,140
Snow Lily Cake.

255
00:11:27,141 --> 00:11:29,140
The way you like it.

256
00:11:29,141 --> 00:11:31,140
Snow Lily Cake.

257
00:11:31,141 --> 00:11:33,140
The words landed like a
stone dropping into still water.

258
00:11:33,141 --> 00:11:35,140
I kept my face exactly where it was.

259
00:11:35,141 --> 00:11:37,140
Soft.

260
00:11:37,140 --> 00:11:39,140
Grateful.

261
00:11:39,141 --> 00:11:41,140
Slightly tearful.

262
00:11:41,289 --> 00:11:43,140
I hated Snow Lily Cake.

263
00:11:43,141 --> 00:11:47,140
I had pushed it aside at
every family dinner for years.

264
00:11:47,141 --> 00:11:53,140
Lucian had sat at our table and watched
me do it more times than I could count.

265
00:11:53,141 --> 00:11:55,140
He knew I hated it.

266
00:11:55,141 --> 00:11:59,140
Which meant he'd just forgotten
who he was pretending to love.

267
00:11:59,141 --> 00:12:01,140
I squeezed his hand once.

268
00:12:01,141 --> 00:12:03,140
That sounds perfect.

269
00:12:03,141 --> 00:12:05,140
I said, he smiled like he'd won something.

270
00:12:05,141 --> 00:12:07,140
You just made a mistake, I thought.

271
00:12:07,639 --> 00:12:11,140
And I'm going to use
a single second of it.

272
00:12:11,141 --> 00:12:15,140
I got back to Coldwood Manor to find
Arya already waiting at the front door.

273
00:12:15,141 --> 00:12:19,140
She grabbed my arm before
I'd even stepped inside.

274
00:12:19,141 --> 00:12:21,140
I went through the East Wing like Mom said.

275
00:12:21,141 --> 00:12:23,140
There's a woman living
in the staff quarters.

276
00:12:23,141 --> 00:12:25,140
Been there six years.

277
00:12:25,141 --> 00:12:27,140
Keeps entirely to herself.

278
00:12:27,189 --> 00:12:29,140
Vivian.

279
00:12:29,939 --> 00:12:31,140
It's Morgana.

280
00:12:31,141 --> 00:12:35,150
I went still.

281
00:12:35,151 --> 00:12:37,150
Mom never told us she stayed.

282
00:12:37,151 --> 00:12:41,150
After Dad died, Mom gave
her a room and let her keep it.

283
00:12:41,151 --> 00:12:43,150
Arya's voice was strange.

284
00:12:43,151 --> 00:12:48,640
She has a mole right side of her neck.

285
00:12:48,641 --> 00:12:50,640
The painting.

286
00:12:50,641 --> 00:12:52,640
The precise, clean edged mole.

287
00:12:52,641 --> 00:12:54,640
The woman with her head
tilted slightly to the right.

288
00:12:54,641 --> 00:12:56,640
What does she eat?

289
00:12:56,641 --> 00:12:58,640
I said, Arya frowned.

290
00:12:58,964 --> 00:13:00,640
What?

291
00:13:00,641 --> 00:13:02,640
Her meal requests.

292
00:13:02,889 --> 00:13:04,640
Did you check them?

293
00:13:04,939 --> 00:13:06,640
I did, actually.

294
00:13:06,641 --> 00:13:08,640
Snow Lily cake.

295
00:13:08,641 --> 00:13:10,640
Arya's eyes narrowed.

296
00:13:10,641 --> 00:13:12,640
He just promised to make me snow Lily cake.

297
00:13:12,641 --> 00:13:14,640
Every morning after we're mated.

298
00:13:14,641 --> 00:13:16,640
Said it was my favorite.

299
00:13:16,641 --> 00:13:18,640
We looked at each other.

300
00:13:18,641 --> 00:13:20,640
He doesn't know you at all.

301
00:13:20,641 --> 00:13:22,640
No.
I casually tossed the jacket in my hand.

302
00:13:22,641 --> 00:13:24,640
He never did.

303
00:13:24,641 --> 00:13:26,640
So all these years.

304
00:13:26,789 --> 00:13:28,640
Every holiday, every packed dinner,

305
00:13:28,789 --> 00:13:30,640
he wasn't coming for me.

306
00:13:30,739 --> 00:13:32,640
The room was quiet.
Then Arya's face shifted.

307
00:13:32,641 --> 00:13:34,640
Not quite a smile.

308
00:13:34,641 --> 00:13:36,640
Something sharper.

309
00:13:36,641 --> 00:13:38,640
So that's what we do.

310
00:13:38,641 --> 00:13:40,640
A cold-willed woman.

311
00:13:40,641 --> 00:13:42,640
We give her more.

312
00:13:42,641 --> 00:13:44,640
Morgana.

313
00:13:44,641 --> 00:13:46,640
Morgana.

314
00:13:46,641 --> 00:13:48,640
I sat down.

315
00:13:48,641 --> 00:13:50,640
Arya dropped onto the
couch across from her.

316
00:13:50,641 --> 00:13:52,640
Does she know about him?

317
00:13:53,389 --> 00:13:54,640
What he's like?

318
00:13:54,641 --> 00:13:56,640
No. Mom needs to handle that carefully.

319
00:13:56,640 --> 00:13:58,640
We give her the full
picture and let her decide.

320
00:13:59,039 --> 00:14:00,640
I paused.

321
00:14:00,641 --> 00:14:02,640
She's been living in the
East Wing for six years.

322
00:14:02,764 --> 00:14:04,640
With nowhere to go.

323
00:14:04,989 --> 00:14:06,640
Lucian can give her a title.

324
00:14:07,189 --> 00:14:08,640
A home. A pack.

325
00:14:08,641 --> 00:14:10,640
We just make sure she understands

326
00:14:10,889 --> 00:14:12,640
exactly what she's walking into.

327
00:14:13,289 --> 00:14:14,640
You're not doing this to hurt her.

328
00:14:14,640 --> 00:14:16,640
Arya said it wasn't a question.

329
00:14:16,641 --> 00:14:18,640
No. I'm doing this to survive.

330
00:14:18,641 --> 00:14:20,640
And so are you.

331
00:14:20,641 --> 00:14:22,640
She nodded slowly.

332
00:14:22,641 --> 00:14:24,640
Then my mother walked
in with two men behind her.

333
00:14:24,641 --> 00:14:26,640
I recognized them immediately.

334
00:14:26,641 --> 00:14:28,640
Lance and Luke Laurent.

335
00:14:28,641 --> 00:14:30,640
Chief Elder Laurent's twin sons.

336
00:14:30,641 --> 00:14:32,640
I'd seen them at high
council ceremonies before.

337
00:14:32,641 --> 00:14:34,640
Always in uniform.

338
00:14:34,641 --> 00:14:36,640
Always in the background.

339
00:14:36,641 --> 00:14:38,640
They weren't in the background now.

340
00:14:38,641 --> 00:14:42,640
My mother looked exhausted
and triumphant at the same time.

341
00:14:42,641 --> 00:14:44,640
I ran all over town.

342
00:14:44,641 --> 00:14:46,640
These two have been
waiting for years apparently.

343
00:14:46,641 --> 00:14:48,640
Good family. Good standing.

344
00:14:48,641 --> 00:14:50,640
Top enforcers in the high council.

345
00:14:50,641 --> 00:14:52,640
She looked at us.
Well, neither of us spoke.

346
00:14:52,641 --> 00:14:54,640
Lance looked at me.

347
00:14:54,641 --> 00:14:56,640
Luke looked at Arya.

348
00:14:56,641 --> 00:15:00,640
Neither of them said anything
pushy or performed anything smooth.

349
00:15:00,641 --> 00:15:02,640
You don't know us.

350
00:15:02,641 --> 00:15:04,640
We can wait.

351
00:15:04,641 --> 00:15:06,640
I looked at Arya. She looked at me.

352
00:15:06,641 --> 00:15:08,640
We didn't have time to be careful.

353
00:15:08,641 --> 00:15:10,640
We didn't have three days to think it over.

354
00:15:10,641 --> 00:15:14,640
Lucian was coming in
three days expecting a bride.

355
00:15:14,641 --> 00:15:16,640
And we needed a plan that held.

356
00:15:16,641 --> 00:15:18,640
Okay.

357
00:15:18,789 --> 00:15:20,640
Arya exhaled.

358
00:15:21,489 --> 00:15:24,640
My mother had the contracts
out before we finished the word.

359
00:15:24,641 --> 00:15:26,640
We signed.

360
00:15:27,039 --> 00:15:30,640
Both of us. Pack seals pressed and
exchanged before the ink was dry.

361
00:15:30,714 --> 00:15:34,640
I held my contract
for a month after.

362
00:15:34,739 --> 00:15:36,640
The name line wasn't blank.

363
00:15:36,641 --> 00:15:39,140
For the first time in three
lifetimes my name was on

364
00:15:39,141 --> 00:15:42,640
a contract next to someone
who had actually chosen me.

365
00:15:42,641 --> 00:15:44,640
It felt strange.

366
00:15:44,641 --> 00:15:46,640
Unfamiliar.

367
00:15:46,641 --> 00:15:48,640
I folded it carefully
and put it in my pocket.

368
00:15:48,641 --> 00:15:50,640
Now we need to talk to Morgana.

369
00:15:50,641 --> 00:15:54,640
Morgana opened the
door on the second knock.

370
00:15:54,641 --> 00:15:56,640
She was younger than I expected.

371
00:15:56,641 --> 00:15:58,640
Maybe 25. Dark hair.

372
00:15:58,641 --> 00:16:00,640
Pale skin.

373
00:16:00,914 --> 00:16:02,640
And yes, there it was.

374
00:16:02,641 --> 00:16:06,640
A small mole on the right side
of her neck just below the jaw.

375
00:16:07,239 --> 00:16:08,548
She looked at me and
Arya standing in her

376
00:16:08,549 --> 00:16:14,240
doorway and her face
went careful and still.

377
00:16:14,241 --> 00:16:16,240
It's cold word. Both of you.

378
00:16:16,289 --> 00:16:18,240
This is unexpected.

379
00:16:18,339 --> 00:16:20,240
Can we come in?

380
00:16:20,241 --> 00:16:22,240
She stepped back without a word.

381
00:16:22,241 --> 00:16:24,240
Her room was small and neat.

382
00:16:24,241 --> 00:16:26,240
A single window. A bookshelf.

383
00:16:26,839 --> 00:16:32,240
On the desk there was a beaten piece
of snow lily cake on a ceramic plate.

384
00:16:32,241 --> 00:16:36,240
I sat down across from
her and didn't waste time.

385
00:16:36,439 --> 00:16:42,640
I'm going to tell you something and I need
you to hear all of it before you respond.

386
00:16:42,641 --> 00:16:44,640
She folded her hands in her lap.

387
00:16:44,641 --> 00:16:48,880
All right?

388
00:16:49,479 --> 00:16:50,880
So I told her.

389
00:16:50,881 --> 00:16:52,880
I told her about the blank contract.

390
00:16:52,881 --> 00:16:56,880
About Lucien coming to Coldwilled
Manor for years always with a reason.

391
00:16:56,881 --> 00:16:58,880
Always finding a way
to stay a little longer.

392
00:16:58,881 --> 00:17:02,880
About the paintings with no
faces on the side of the neck.

393
00:17:02,979 --> 00:17:04,880
About the snow lily cake.

394
00:17:04,929 --> 00:17:06,880
When I finished, the room was quiet.

395
00:17:06,881 --> 00:17:08,880
Morgana looked at the half-eaten cake

396
00:17:09,179 --> 00:17:10,880
on her desk for a long moment.

397
00:17:10,881 --> 00:17:12,880
How long have you known?

398
00:17:13,129 --> 00:17:16,700
Two days.

399
00:17:16,701 --> 00:17:18,700
She nodded slowly.

400
00:17:18,701 --> 00:17:20,700
And you're here because you
want me to take your place.

401
00:17:20,701 --> 00:17:22,700
I'm here because you
deserve to know the truth.

402
00:17:22,701 --> 00:17:28,270
What you do with
it is your choice.

403
00:17:28,419 --> 00:17:30,270
She was quiet for a long time.

404
00:17:30,319 --> 00:17:34,270
He never told me he was
trying to marry your family.

405
00:17:34,444 --> 00:17:36,270
Her voice was flat. Not hurt.

406
00:17:36,444 --> 00:17:38,270
Just flat like she was
filing something away.

407
00:17:38,271 --> 00:17:42,270
He said he was working on
a way for us to be together.

408
00:17:42,270 --> 00:17:44,270
That it was complicated.

409
00:17:44,271 --> 00:17:46,270
That I needed to be patient.

410
00:17:46,271 --> 00:17:48,270
Arya made a small side beside me.

411
00:17:48,271 --> 00:17:52,190
Morgana looked up.

412
00:17:52,191 --> 00:17:54,190
What happens to me if I go?

413
00:17:54,239 --> 00:17:58,140
You get a title.

414
00:17:58,141 --> 00:18:00,140
A home.

415
00:18:00,140 --> 00:18:02,140
A pack.

416
00:18:02,141 --> 00:18:06,140
You stop living in a room
in someone else's manor.

417
00:18:06,141 --> 00:18:08,140
Waiting for a man who's
been lying to you for years.

418
00:18:08,141 --> 00:18:11,680
And what does he get?

419
00:18:11,681 --> 00:18:13,680
Exactly what he deserves.

420
00:18:13,681 --> 00:18:15,680
Arya said.

421
00:18:15,681 --> 00:18:17,680
Morgana looked at her.

422
00:18:17,681 --> 00:18:19,680
Then back at me.

423
00:18:19,681 --> 00:18:21,680
I have a brother.

424
00:18:21,681 --> 00:18:25,020
He's in debt.

425
00:18:25,021 --> 00:18:27,020
Lucien's been using that
to keep me cooperative.

426
00:18:27,021 --> 00:18:29,020
She met my eyes.

427
00:18:29,021 --> 00:18:32,460
If I do this, I need him protected.

428
00:18:32,461 --> 00:18:34,460
Give me his name.

429
00:18:34,461 --> 00:18:36,460
I'll have it handled before the wedding.

430
00:18:36,461 --> 00:18:39,780
She studied my face for a moment.

431
00:18:39,781 --> 00:18:45,570
Then she stood up
and smoothed her dress.

432
00:18:45,571 --> 00:18:50,350
I'll need to know what to wear.

433
00:18:50,351 --> 00:18:54,350
The morning of the wedding, Arya and
my mother dressed Morgana in the east wing

434
00:18:54,499 --> 00:18:56,350
while I waited by the front gate.

435
00:18:56,351 --> 00:18:58,350
The scent blocking veil covered everything.

436
00:18:58,524 --> 00:19:00,350
Her face.

437
00:19:00,351 --> 00:19:02,350
Her neck. Her hair.

438
00:19:02,351 --> 00:19:04,350
From the outside she
was just a bride in white.

439
00:19:04,524 --> 00:19:06,350
Lucien's motor cord
arrived exactly on time.

440
00:19:06,351 --> 00:19:12,350
He stepped out and looked at my
mother with that perfect controlled smile.

441
00:19:12,351 --> 00:19:14,350
Where's Vivian?

442
00:19:14,351 --> 00:19:16,350
She wanted it kept quiet.

443
00:19:16,351 --> 00:19:18,350
You know how she feels about attention.

444
00:19:18,351 --> 00:19:20,350
He nodded once.

445
00:19:20,749 --> 00:19:24,350
He walked to the car where Morgana
sat waiting and held out his hand.

446
00:19:24,351 --> 00:19:26,350
She took it. He didn't hesitate.

447
00:19:26,351 --> 00:19:28,350
Didn't pause.

448
00:19:28,351 --> 00:19:30,350
Didn't notice anything at all.

449
00:19:30,649 --> 00:19:32,350
The motorcade pulled away.

450
00:19:32,351 --> 00:19:36,350
I stood at the gate and watched
till it disappeared around the corner.

451
00:19:36,351 --> 00:19:38,350
Arya appeared beside me.

452
00:19:38,351 --> 00:19:40,350
She didn't say anything for a moment.

453
00:19:40,351 --> 00:19:42,350
Do you think he'll figure it
out before the ceremony?

454
00:19:42,351 --> 00:19:44,350
No, he'll be too busy
being pleased with himself.

455
00:19:44,351 --> 00:19:47,920
She almost smiled.

456
00:19:47,921 --> 00:19:51,260
And after?

457
00:19:51,261 --> 00:19:54,990
I turned back toward the house.

458
00:19:54,991 --> 00:20:01,150
After?

459
00:20:01,151 --> 00:20:03,150
It's going to be very interesting.

460
00:20:03,349 --> 00:20:05,150
They grabbed me the net.

461
00:20:10,960 --> 00:20:20,960
Arya and I had gone out to look at
jewelry for our own upcoming ceremonies.

462
00:20:20,961 --> 00:20:24,960
I stopped at a small cafe to
wait while she went ahead.

463
00:20:24,961 --> 00:20:26,960
Two men came out of nowhere.

464
00:20:27,109 --> 00:20:28,960
One hand over my mouth.

465
00:20:28,961 --> 00:20:30,960
One arm around my waist.

466
00:20:30,961 --> 00:20:34,960
I released my inner
wolf and fought hard.

467
00:20:34,961 --> 00:20:36,960
They decided it was easier to knock me out.

468
00:20:36,961 --> 00:20:38,960
When I opened my eyes,

469
00:20:39,609 --> 00:20:40,960
I was in a bedroom at Valerius Manor.

470
00:20:40,961 --> 00:20:42,960
Lucian sat on the edge of the bed.

471
00:20:42,961 --> 00:20:44,960
His eyes were red.

472
00:20:44,961 --> 00:20:46,960
Not from crying.

473
00:20:46,961 --> 00:20:50,960
From something that had been
burning all night and hadn't gone out.

474
00:20:50,961 --> 00:20:52,960
He looked at me the
way he used to look at me.

475
00:20:52,961 --> 00:20:54,960
He looked at me.

476
00:20:54,961 --> 00:20:58,960
He looked at me the way he
used to look at territory disputes.

477
00:20:58,961 --> 00:21:00,960
Like a problem that
needed to be solved by force.

478
00:21:00,961 --> 00:21:02,960
Explain.

479
00:21:02,961 --> 00:21:04,960
I sat up slowly.

480
00:21:04,961 --> 00:21:06,960
My head was still ringing.

481
00:21:06,961 --> 00:21:10,370
Explain what?

482
00:21:10,371 --> 00:21:12,370
You sent a contract with no name.

483
00:21:12,371 --> 00:21:14,370
Anyone could have shown up.

484
00:21:14,371 --> 00:21:16,370
That's not my problem.

485
00:21:16,371 --> 00:21:20,960
He grabbed the bed hold beside my head.

486
00:21:20,961 --> 00:21:22,960
Not touching me.

487
00:21:22,961 --> 00:21:24,960
Just close enough that
I couldn't ignore him.

488
00:21:24,961 --> 00:21:26,960
Vivian.

489
00:21:27,309 --> 00:21:28,960
Don't.

490
00:21:28,961 --> 00:21:30,960
His voice was very quiet.

491
00:21:30,961 --> 00:21:32,960
Don't what?

492
00:21:32,961 --> 00:21:34,960
I met his eyes.

493
00:21:34,961 --> 00:21:36,960
You got a cold-willed woman.

494
00:21:37,059 --> 00:21:38,960
Isn't that what you wanted?

495
00:21:38,961 --> 00:21:40,960
Something moved across his face.

496
00:21:40,961 --> 00:21:42,960
Fast.

497
00:21:42,961 --> 00:21:46,500
Gone before I could name it.

498
00:21:46,501 --> 00:21:48,500
You know that's not what I wanted.

499
00:21:48,501 --> 00:21:50,500
Do I?

500
00:21:50,501 --> 00:21:52,500
Because your contract didn't say my name.

501
00:21:52,501 --> 00:21:56,500
And last night, apparently
went just fine without me.

502
00:21:56,501 --> 00:22:00,740
Your jaw tightened.

503
00:22:00,939 --> 00:22:04,880
The room was dark. I didn't know it.

504
00:22:04,881 --> 00:22:06,880
And yet you didn't send her home.

505
00:22:06,881 --> 00:22:08,880
Silence.

506
00:22:08,881 --> 00:22:10,880
The air in the room smelled like snow lily.

507
00:22:10,881 --> 00:22:12,880
Faint but unrestakeable.

508
00:22:12,881 --> 00:22:14,880
Her pheromones.
Still clinging to everything.

509
00:22:14,881 --> 00:22:16,880
I looked at the rumpled sheets.

510
00:22:16,881 --> 00:22:18,880
At the two glasses on the nightstand.

511
00:22:18,881 --> 00:22:20,880
At Lucian standing there with his red eyes

512
00:22:20,881 --> 00:22:22,880
and his clenched jaw furious
at me for something he did.

513
00:22:22,881 --> 00:22:24,880
You son of a bitch.

514
00:22:24,881 --> 00:22:26,880
I said out loud. He flinched. Good.

515
00:22:26,881 --> 00:22:28,880
You brought me here against my will.

516
00:22:28,881 --> 00:22:32,880
You dragged me into the room where you
just spent the night with another woman.

517
00:22:32,881 --> 00:22:36,220
And now you want me to explain myself.

518
00:22:36,221 --> 00:22:38,220
Vivian.

519
00:22:38,221 --> 00:22:40,220
Tell your men to bring my car around.

520
00:22:40,221 --> 00:22:42,220
I'm leaving.

521
00:22:42,269 --> 00:22:44,220
He grabbed my wrist.

522
00:22:44,719 --> 00:22:46,220
You're not leaving.

523
00:22:46,221 --> 00:22:48,220
His grip was iron.

524
00:22:48,221 --> 00:22:52,220
You're going to sit down
and you're going to listen.

525
00:22:52,221 --> 00:22:54,220
And then we're going to fix this.

526
00:22:54,221 --> 00:22:56,220
Fix what?

527
00:22:56,221 --> 00:22:58,220
I pulled against his hold.
There's nothing to fix.

528
00:22:58,221 --> 00:23:00,220
You made your choices. I made mine.

529
00:23:00,221 --> 00:23:02,220
What choices?

530
00:23:02,221 --> 00:23:04,220
His voice cracked.

531
00:23:04,221 --> 00:23:06,220
Just slightly.

532
00:23:06,221 --> 00:23:08,220
You signed a contract with someone else.

533
00:23:08,444 --> 00:23:12,220
When? How? You were
supposed to... He stopped himself.

534
00:23:12,221 --> 00:23:14,220
I looked at him.

535
00:23:14,369 --> 00:23:16,220
I was supposed to what?

536
00:23:16,221 --> 00:23:18,220
Wait for you?

537
00:23:18,221 --> 00:23:20,220
Except whatever you decided to give me?

538
00:23:20,221 --> 00:23:22,220
I pulled my wrist free.

539
00:23:22,221 --> 00:23:24,220
I did that once.

540
00:23:24,221 --> 00:23:26,220
It didn't end well.

541
00:23:26,221 --> 00:23:28,220
Just a second.

542
00:23:28,221 --> 00:23:30,220
Something in his expression shifted.

543
00:23:30,221 --> 00:23:32,220
Confused. Almost lost.

544
00:23:32,221 --> 00:23:34,220
Then the door opened
and Alpha Various walked in.

545
00:23:34,221 --> 00:23:36,220
Followed by Luna Various.

546
00:23:36,221 --> 00:23:38,220
Luna Various rushed toward
me with both hands out.

547
00:23:38,221 --> 00:23:40,220
Vivian, sweetheart. You're finally up.

548
00:23:40,221 --> 00:23:42,220
She reached for my hair.

549
00:23:42,221 --> 00:23:44,220
Smoothing it back like I was 12 years old.

550
00:23:44,221 --> 00:23:46,220
The morning after greeting
ceremony is in an hour.

551
00:23:46,221 --> 00:23:48,220
We've been so excited for this day.

552
00:23:49,219 --> 00:23:50,220
I stepped back out of her reach.

553
00:23:50,221 --> 00:23:53,600
Ma'am.

554
00:23:53,601 --> 00:23:55,600
I said calmly.

555
00:23:55,649 --> 00:23:57,600
You have the wrong person.

556
00:23:57,601 --> 00:23:59,600
Luna Various's laughed.

557
00:23:59,601 --> 00:24:01,600
A nervous, uncertain sound.

558
00:24:01,600 --> 00:24:03,600
What do you mean wrong person?

559
00:24:03,601 --> 00:24:05,600
Sweetheart, you're Vivian.

560
00:24:07,799 --> 00:24:09,600
We've known you since you were a child.

561
00:24:09,601 --> 00:24:11,600
Yes.

562
00:24:11,601 --> 00:24:13,183
Which is why you can
call Chief Elder LaRonde

563
00:24:13,184 --> 00:24:15,600
right now and ask him
where I was two nights ago.

564
00:24:17,749 --> 00:24:19,600
The room went quiet.

565
00:24:19,649 --> 00:24:21,600
Alpha Various looked at his son.

566
00:24:21,601 --> 00:24:23,600
Lucian said nothing.

567
00:24:23,601 --> 00:24:25,600
Sir, your son sent a contract with no name.

568
00:24:25,601 --> 00:24:27,600
I declined.

569
00:24:27,601 --> 00:24:31,140
Someone else accepted.

570
00:24:31,239 --> 00:24:33,140
I kept my voice even.

571
00:24:34,990 --> 00:24:37,140
The woman who came to this
house two days ago was not me.

572
00:24:37,141 --> 00:24:41,140
I was at Coldwell Manor having dinner
with Chief Elder LaRonde and his wife.

573
00:24:43,140 --> 00:24:45,140
Luna Various looked between me and Lucian.

574
00:24:45,141 --> 00:24:49,140
That's not... The servants said
the bride arrived in the convoy.

575
00:24:49,141 --> 00:24:51,140
She did.

576
00:24:51,141 --> 00:24:53,140
Her name is Morgana.

577
00:24:53,141 --> 00:24:55,140
She's been living at
Coldwell Manor for six years.

578
00:24:55,141 --> 00:24:57,140
I paused.

579
00:24:57,189 --> 00:24:59,140
She also has a mole on
the right side of her neck.

580
00:24:59,141 --> 00:25:01,140
In case anyone needs confirmation.

581
00:25:01,141 --> 00:25:03,140
The silence that followed was very long.

582
00:25:03,141 --> 00:25:05,301
Luna Various has sat down
hard in the chair behind her.

583
00:25:07,140 --> 00:25:09,140
Alpha Various turned to Lucian.

584
00:25:09,141 --> 00:25:11,140
Slow.

585
00:25:11,141 --> 00:25:15,140
The way a man turns when he already knows
the answer and doesn't want to hear it.

586
00:25:15,141 --> 00:25:19,630
Lucian's mouth tightened.

587
00:25:19,631 --> 00:25:21,630
He didn't answer.

588
00:25:21,631 --> 00:25:27,040
Lucian... Various's
voice dropped.

589
00:25:27,041 --> 00:25:31,150
Who is she?

590
00:25:31,151 --> 00:25:33,150
Lucian stopped.

591
00:25:33,349 --> 00:25:35,150
Started again.

592
00:25:35,151 --> 00:25:37,150
She was connected to the Coldwood family.

593
00:25:37,151 --> 00:25:39,150
She's been under their care for years.

594
00:25:39,151 --> 00:25:41,150
It's not what it looks like.

595
00:25:41,299 --> 00:25:45,780
Then what does it look like?

596
00:25:45,781 --> 00:25:47,780
He shot me a look.

597
00:25:47,781 --> 00:25:49,780
Sharp and warning.

598
00:25:49,780 --> 00:25:51,780
I ignored it.

599
00:25:51,781 --> 00:25:53,780
Your son has been in
love with her for years.

600
00:25:53,781 --> 00:25:55,780
He came to Coldwell
Manor every chance he got.

601
00:25:55,781 --> 00:25:57,780
Not for me.

602
00:25:57,781 --> 00:25:59,780
For her.

603
00:25:59,781 --> 00:26:01,780
I looked at Alpha Various.

604
00:26:01,781 --> 00:26:03,780
His study is full of her portraits.

605
00:26:03,781 --> 00:26:05,780
Ask him to show you the one
in the hidden compartment.

606
00:26:05,781 --> 00:26:07,780
Lucian went pale.

607
00:26:07,829 --> 00:26:09,780
Vivian.

608
00:26:09,781 --> 00:26:11,780
His voice came out low and tight.

609
00:26:11,781 --> 00:26:13,780
That's enough.

610
00:26:13,781 --> 00:26:15,780
Alpha Various said he
didn't raise his voice.

611
00:26:17,780 --> 00:26:24,380
He didn't have to.

612
00:26:24,381 --> 00:26:26,380
Get me Chief Elder Laurent on the phone.

613
00:26:26,381 --> 00:26:28,380
He said to the nearest guard.

614
00:26:28,455 --> 00:26:30,380
Now.

615
00:26:30,381 --> 00:26:32,380
Lucian turned to me.

616
00:26:32,381 --> 00:26:34,380
His composure was
cracking at the edges now.

617
00:26:34,381 --> 00:26:36,380
Something raw and
desperate bleeding through.

618
00:26:36,381 --> 00:26:38,380
You didn't have to do this.

619
00:26:38,381 --> 00:26:40,380
He said quietly.

620
00:26:40,381 --> 00:26:42,380
Alpha Various looked at me.

621
00:26:42,381 --> 00:26:44,380
Then at his son.

622
00:26:44,381 --> 00:26:46,380
Something shifted behind his eyes.

623
00:26:46,381 --> 00:26:48,380
Calculation.

624
00:26:48,381 --> 00:26:50,380
The same calculation I'd
seen in Lucian a hundred times.

625
00:26:50,380 --> 00:26:53,890
He cleared his throat.

626
00:26:53,965 --> 00:26:55,890
Vivian.

627
00:26:55,891 --> 00:26:57,890
This is an embarrassing
situation for everyone.

628
00:26:57,891 --> 00:26:59,890
Let's handle it quietly.

629
00:26:59,891 --> 00:27:01,890
Lucian and Morgana
are properly made it now.

630
00:27:01,891 --> 00:27:03,890
We acknowledge it
internally and move forward.

631
00:27:03,891 --> 00:27:05,890
He tried for a reasonable smile.

632
00:27:05,891 --> 00:27:07,890
No reason this has to leave these walls.

633
00:27:07,891 --> 00:27:11,390
I stared at him.

634
00:27:11,391 --> 00:27:13,390
Luna Valerce recovered fast.

635
00:27:13,540 --> 00:27:14,390
Too fast.

636
00:27:14,391 --> 00:27:16,390
Yes.

637
00:27:16,391 --> 00:27:18,390
Vivian, you're a sensible girl.

638
00:27:18,391 --> 00:27:21,390
You understand how these things work.

639
00:27:21,391 --> 00:27:24,390
A little discretion now saves
everyone a great deal of trouble.

640
00:27:24,391 --> 00:27:26,390
I looked at the two of them.

641
00:27:26,391 --> 00:27:28,390
Then at Lucian.

642
00:27:28,391 --> 00:27:31,390
Three generations of the same thing.

643
00:27:31,391 --> 00:27:33,390
Smiling faces.

644
00:27:33,391 --> 00:27:35,390
Reasonable voices.

645
00:27:35,391 --> 00:27:40,390
And underneath the absolute certainty
that I would comply because it was easier.

646
00:27:40,391 --> 00:27:42,390
I had complied once.

647
00:27:42,391 --> 00:27:46,020
I knew exactly how that ended.

648
00:27:46,219 --> 00:27:48,020
Call Chief Elder Laurent.

649
00:27:48,669 --> 00:27:52,900
I'll wait.

650
00:27:52,949 --> 00:27:54,900
They didn't call Laurent.

651
00:27:54,901 --> 00:27:57,900
Instead, Alpha Valerce told the guards
to keep me in the East guest room

652
00:27:57,901 --> 00:28:01,900
until he and Lucian returned from
what he called a necessary visit.

653
00:28:03,769 --> 00:28:05,470
I knew where they were going.

654
00:28:05,471 --> 00:28:07,711
I sat on the edge of the bed
and ran through the numbers.

655
00:28:07,894 --> 00:28:09,470
Laurent was reasonable.

656
00:28:09,669 --> 00:28:11,470
He didn't like drama.

657
00:28:11,471 --> 00:28:13,470
In another life he'd
stayed out of it entirely.

658
00:28:13,470 --> 00:28:15,470
But this life was different.

659
00:28:15,994 --> 00:28:17,470
This life I was his daughter-in-law.

660
00:28:17,471 --> 00:28:19,470
The question was whether
he'd answer the door.

661
00:28:19,471 --> 00:28:21,470
Two hours passed.

662
00:28:21,471 --> 00:28:23,470
Then Lucian came back alone.

663
00:28:23,471 --> 00:28:25,470
He walked in and closed
the door behind him.

664
00:28:25,519 --> 00:28:27,470
He didn't look at me right away.

665
00:28:27,471 --> 00:28:31,470
He stood with one hand on the door
handle, jaw tight, staring at the floor.

666
00:28:31,471 --> 00:28:33,470
Laurent's talked to us.

667
00:28:33,471 --> 00:28:35,470
He said finally.

668
00:28:35,471 --> 00:28:37,470
And?

669
00:28:37,471 --> 00:28:39,470
He said it wasn't his place to get involved
in another pack's internal matters.

670
00:28:39,471 --> 00:28:43,620
Lucian looked up.

671
00:28:43,621 --> 00:28:45,620
He's not going to intervene.

672
00:28:45,621 --> 00:28:47,620
Something cold moved through my chest.

673
00:28:47,621 --> 00:28:49,620
I kept my face still.

674
00:28:49,621 --> 00:28:51,620
Then you have what you want, I said.

675
00:28:51,621 --> 00:28:53,620
Let me go home.

676
00:28:53,621 --> 00:28:55,620
I can't.

677
00:28:55,621 --> 00:28:57,620
He crossed the room.

678
00:28:57,621 --> 00:28:59,620
Not aggressive, almost tired.

679
00:28:59,621 --> 00:29:01,620
My mother's right.

680
00:29:01,621 --> 00:29:08,190
Everything stays clean.

681
00:29:08,191 --> 00:29:10,190
You want me to pretend to be your mate?

682
00:29:10,191 --> 00:29:12,190
I want you to be my mate.

683
00:29:12,191 --> 00:29:15,630
He stopped in front of me.

684
00:29:15,631 --> 00:29:17,630
Vivian, I know this
isn't how you wanted it.

685
00:29:17,631 --> 00:29:19,630
But I can make it work.

686
00:29:19,631 --> 00:29:21,630
I can make it good.

687
00:29:21,631 --> 00:29:23,630
You know I can.

688
00:29:23,631 --> 00:29:25,630
I looked at him.

689
00:29:25,854 --> 00:29:27,630
He used to be able to say things
like that and make me feel safe.

690
00:29:27,631 --> 00:29:29,630
Now it just made me tired.

691
00:29:29,631 --> 00:29:34,670
No. His expression hardened.

692
00:29:34,694 --> 00:29:36,670
Then I don't have a choice.

693
00:29:36,671 --> 00:29:40,210
I shoved him back hard.

694
00:29:40,309 --> 00:29:44,210
He caught my wrists and his
alpha aura hit the room like a wave.

695
00:29:44,211 --> 00:29:47,210
Pressing down on my inner
wolf until she went silent and still.

696
00:29:47,211 --> 00:29:49,210
I fought anyway.

697
00:29:49,211 --> 00:29:52,210
I twisted and kicked and
refused to stop moving.

698
00:29:52,211 --> 00:29:54,210
It didn't matter. He was stronger.

699
00:29:54,211 --> 00:29:56,210
He'd always been stronger.

700
00:29:56,211 --> 00:29:57,210
Stop.

701
00:29:57,211 --> 00:30:00,210
He said, not angry, worse
than angry, resigned.

702
00:30:00,211 --> 00:30:02,210
Like this was just something
that had to happen.

703
00:30:02,211 --> 00:30:04,210
My back hit the mattress.

704
00:30:04,211 --> 00:30:08,210
Lucian, my voice came out steady
even though nothing else was.

705
00:30:08,211 --> 00:30:10,210
Don't do this.

706
00:30:10,211 --> 00:30:12,210
He didn't answer.

707
00:30:12,211 --> 00:30:15,210
The alpha aura pressed harder.

708
00:30:15,211 --> 00:30:18,210
My inner wolf went completely quiet.

709
00:30:18,211 --> 00:30:20,210
My arms stopped responding.

710
00:30:20,211 --> 00:30:22,210
This was it.

711
00:30:22,211 --> 00:30:25,210
This was exactly how it ended last time.

712
00:30:25,211 --> 00:30:28,210
Except last time there
had been no one coming.

713
00:30:28,211 --> 00:30:30,210
The door exploded open.

714
00:30:31,009 --> 00:30:33,210
Arya stood in the frame, breathing hard.

715
00:30:33,484 --> 00:30:35,210
A silver blade in both hands.

716
00:30:35,211 --> 00:30:37,210
Get your hands off my sister.

717
00:30:37,384 --> 00:30:38,210
Now.

718
00:30:38,211 --> 00:30:40,210
Lucian turned his head.

719
00:30:40,211 --> 00:30:43,210
He looked at her the way you look
at something small and inconvenient.

720
00:30:43,211 --> 00:30:46,210
He raised one hand and
released a pulse of alpha aura.

721
00:30:46,211 --> 00:30:51,210
The blade flew out of Arya's
grip and hit the far wall.

722
00:30:51,211 --> 00:30:53,210
She stumbled.

723
00:30:53,211 --> 00:30:55,210
Caught herself on the door warm.

724
00:30:55,259 --> 00:30:57,210
Lucian turned back to me.

725
00:30:57,211 --> 00:30:59,210
Arya looked at me from across the room.

726
00:30:59,211 --> 00:31:00,210
Her hands were empty.

727
00:31:00,211 --> 00:31:01,210
Her eyes were not.

728
00:31:01,211 --> 00:31:02,210
I'm sorry.

729
00:31:02,211 --> 00:31:03,210
She mouthed.

730
00:31:03,211 --> 00:31:05,210
The door behind her was still open.

731
00:31:05,309 --> 00:31:07,210
And then I heard footsteps in the hall.

732
00:31:07,210 --> 00:31:10,210
Chief Elder Lawrence walked in.

733
00:31:10,210 --> 00:31:12,210
He took one look at the room.

734
00:31:12,211 --> 00:31:14,210
At me on the bed.

735
00:31:14,211 --> 00:31:16,210
At Arya's empty hands.

736
00:31:16,211 --> 00:31:18,210
At Lucian standing over me.

737
00:31:18,211 --> 00:31:19,210
Step back.

738
00:31:19,211 --> 00:31:22,210
He said he didn't raise his voice.

739
00:31:22,211 --> 00:31:25,780
Lucian didn't move immediately.

740
00:31:26,279 --> 00:31:30,780
For one long second he stayed exactly
where he was and the room held its breath.

741
00:31:30,879 --> 00:31:32,780
Then he stepped back.

742
00:31:32,781 --> 00:31:34,780
Laurent walked to the center of the room.

743
00:31:35,079 --> 00:31:38,780
Behind him came an older man I
recognized from high council ceremonies.

744
00:31:38,781 --> 00:31:40,780
White haired, unharried.

745
00:31:40,879 --> 00:31:41,780
The royal seer.

746
00:31:41,781 --> 00:31:43,780
The alpha king's personal emise.

747
00:31:43,781 --> 00:31:45,780
Who had served the throne for 50 years.

748
00:31:45,781 --> 00:31:47,780
I sat up slowly.

749
00:31:47,781 --> 00:31:49,780
Laurent looked at Lucian.

750
00:31:49,781 --> 00:31:51,780
When your father came to me this afternoon.

751
00:31:51,781 --> 00:31:52,780
He said.

752
00:31:52,781 --> 00:31:56,780
He asked me to stay out of
another pack's internal matters.

753
00:31:56,781 --> 00:31:59,780
He clipped his hands behind his back.

754
00:31:59,781 --> 00:32:02,780
He was right that I
don't enjoy interfering.

755
00:32:02,781 --> 00:32:03,780
He paused.

756
00:32:03,781 --> 00:32:05,780
He was wrong about what this is.

757
00:32:05,781 --> 00:32:07,780
Lucian's eyes moved to the royal seal.

758
00:32:07,781 --> 00:32:09,780
Something in his face changed.

759
00:32:09,781 --> 00:32:11,780
Laurent said nodding toward me.

760
00:32:11,781 --> 00:32:13,780
This woman is my daughter-in-law.

761
00:32:13,781 --> 00:32:16,780
The contract was signed
and sealed three days ago.

762
00:32:16,781 --> 00:32:19,780
He looked at Alpha Valeris who
had appeared in the doorway.

763
00:32:19,781 --> 00:32:21,780
Your son kidnapped her this morning.

764
00:32:21,781 --> 00:32:23,780
Held her against her will.

765
00:32:23,781 --> 00:32:26,780
And just now attempted
to assault her in this room.

766
00:32:26,781 --> 00:32:28,780
He let that sit for a moment.

767
00:32:28,781 --> 00:32:30,780
I was outside the door.

768
00:32:30,781 --> 00:32:31,780
I heard everything.

769
00:32:31,781 --> 00:32:34,780
The room was completely silent.

770
00:32:34,781 --> 00:32:36,780
The royal sea was with me.

771
00:32:36,781 --> 00:32:38,780
Laurent continued.

772
00:32:38,781 --> 00:32:41,780
As a neutral witness at
the Alpha King's request.

773
00:32:41,781 --> 00:32:43,780
Alpha Valeris looked at Lucian.

774
00:32:43,781 --> 00:32:45,780
Then at the Seer.

775
00:32:45,781 --> 00:32:47,780
Then back at Lucian.

776
00:32:47,781 --> 00:32:50,780
Whatever calculation he'd been
running died behind his eyes.

777
00:32:50,781 --> 00:32:52,780
The Seer stepped forward.

778
00:32:52,781 --> 00:32:53,780
I've seen enough.

779
00:32:53,781 --> 00:32:54,780
He said simply.

780
00:32:54,781 --> 00:32:56,780
I'll be reporting directly
to the Alpha King.

781
00:32:58,179 --> 00:33:01,300
Lucian turned to me.

782
00:33:01,301 --> 00:33:02,300
Fast.

783
00:33:02,301 --> 00:33:03,301
Desperate.

784
00:33:03,599 --> 00:33:05,300
He took one step towards me.

785
00:33:05,300 --> 00:33:07,300
Tell them it wasn't what it looked like.

786
00:33:07,301 --> 00:33:10,300
Tell them you came willingly just say that.

787
00:33:10,301 --> 00:33:11,300
One sentence.

788
00:33:11,301 --> 00:33:12,300
I looked at him.

789
00:33:12,301 --> 00:33:15,300
This man had poisoned
me, mutilated my sister.

790
00:33:15,449 --> 00:33:18,300
Spent three lifetimes
treating us like tools

791
00:33:18,301 --> 00:33:21,300
and then discarding us
when we stopped being useful.

792
00:33:21,301 --> 00:33:23,300
And now he was asking
me for one more thing.

793
00:33:23,749 --> 00:33:27,220
Not a chance.

794
00:33:28,569 --> 00:33:31,220
Laurent put his hand out toward me.

795
00:33:31,221 --> 00:33:33,220
I took it and stood up.

796
00:33:33,221 --> 00:33:36,220
Arya Appyr appeared at my side immediately.

797
00:33:37,019 --> 00:33:38,220
She didn't say anything.

798
00:33:38,245 --> 00:33:40,220
We watched the guards move in.

799
00:33:40,221 --> 00:33:42,220
Luna Valerius started crying.

800
00:33:43,144 --> 00:33:46,220
Alpha Valerius stood very still
with the expression of a man

801
00:33:46,221 --> 00:33:49,220
watching everything he
built from a part of the scenes.

802
00:33:49,221 --> 00:33:53,220
Lucian didn't look away from me until
the guards put their hands on his arms.

803
00:33:53,221 --> 00:33:54,220
Even then.

804
00:33:54,221 --> 00:33:56,220
Even as they walked him out.

805
00:33:56,221 --> 00:33:58,220
He kept looking back.

806
00:33:58,221 --> 00:34:00,220
The verdict came fast.

807
00:34:00,270 --> 00:34:01,245
Lucian.

808
00:34:01,269 --> 00:34:04,220
Eight years of exile in
the northern wastelands.

809
00:34:04,221 --> 00:34:06,220
Soulbinding shackles.

810
00:34:06,269 --> 00:34:08,219
His inner wolf sealed for the duration.

811
00:34:08,220 --> 00:34:10,219
Alpha Valerius and Luna Valerius.

812
00:34:10,220 --> 00:34:12,736
Five years for aiding
covering up an unlawful

813
00:34:12,760 --> 00:34:15,219
detention of a high
council member's family.

814
00:34:15,220 --> 00:34:16,219
Their pact title stripped.

815
00:34:16,220 --> 00:34:18,219
The blood moon pact dissolved.

816
00:34:18,220 --> 00:34:21,219
Valerius' manner seized and
transferred to high council jurisdiction.

817
00:34:21,220 --> 00:34:23,219
All of it done in 72 hours.

818
00:34:23,220 --> 00:34:27,219
Arya found me in the garden the
morning the verdict was announced.

819
00:34:27,320 --> 00:34:34,620
She sat down beside me without
saying anything for a while.

820
00:34:34,621 --> 00:34:35,620
Then.

821
00:34:35,621 --> 00:34:36,620
Morgana.

822
00:34:36,621 --> 00:34:37,621
I looked up.

823
00:34:38,170 --> 00:34:41,060
She's on the street.

824
00:34:41,061 --> 00:34:42,060
Packs gone.

825
00:34:42,061 --> 00:34:43,060
Manners sealed.

826
00:34:43,061 --> 00:34:46,060
She tried to go back to the underground
clubs but nobody will take her.

827
00:34:46,061 --> 00:34:47,060
She paused.

828
00:34:47,061 --> 00:34:48,061
Viviana.

829
00:34:48,410 --> 00:34:50,060
That painting got out.

830
00:34:50,061 --> 00:34:52,060
Everyone knows.

831
00:34:52,610 --> 00:34:54,060
I didn't say anything.

832
00:34:54,160 --> 00:34:56,060
Are you sorry for her?

833
00:34:56,061 --> 00:34:57,060
No.

834
00:34:57,061 --> 00:34:59,060
I thought about it honestly.

835
00:34:59,360 --> 00:35:01,060
Morgana had known what she was doing.

836
00:35:01,061 --> 00:35:05,023
She'd let my father's household shelter
her for six years while she maintained a

837
00:35:05,047 --> 00:35:09,072
secret arrangement with the man who would
later poison me and mutilate my sister.

838
00:35:09,073 --> 00:35:11,060
She hadn't warned anyone.

839
00:35:11,110 --> 00:35:13,060
She hadn't chosen differently
when she had the chance.

840
00:35:13,061 --> 00:35:15,060
Her consequences were her own.

841
00:35:15,061 --> 00:35:16,061
Either am I.

842
00:35:16,410 --> 00:35:18,060
We sat there for a moment.

843
00:35:18,610 --> 00:35:21,060
Then Arya straightened up.

844
00:35:21,061 --> 00:35:22,060
So.

845
00:35:22,061 --> 00:35:24,060
Lawrence Brothers.

846
00:35:24,210 --> 00:35:25,060
Lawrence Brothers.

847
00:35:25,061 --> 00:35:26,060
I agreed.

848
00:35:26,061 --> 00:35:27,060
She smoothed her dress.

849
00:35:27,061 --> 00:35:28,060
Failed completely.

850
00:35:28,061 --> 00:35:30,060
Luke said he's been
interested since I was six.

851
00:35:30,061 --> 00:35:31,060
Six.

852
00:35:31,061 --> 00:35:32,060
Vivian.

853
00:35:32,061 --> 00:35:34,060
He's been waiting 14 years.

854
00:35:34,061 --> 00:35:39,060
Lance told me he watched me wait
at the border post for a whole month.

855
00:35:39,110 --> 00:35:43,060
When Lucian came back injured and I
wouldn't leave until I knew he was okay.

856
00:35:43,061 --> 00:35:44,060
I paused.

857
00:35:44,061 --> 00:35:46,060
He said that was when he knew.

858
00:35:46,061 --> 00:35:48,060
Arya looked at me sideways.

859
00:35:48,110 --> 00:35:50,060
You waited a month at
a border post for Lucian?

860
00:35:50,061 --> 00:35:51,061
I was 17.

861
00:35:51,260 --> 00:35:52,136
You were an idiot.

862
00:35:52,160 --> 00:35:53,060
I was 17.

863
00:35:53,061 --> 00:35:54,061
I repeated.

864
00:35:54,810 --> 00:35:57,060
She almost smiled.

865
00:35:57,360 --> 00:36:02,060
The Laurent Brothers arrived at
Coldwell Manor that afternoon.

866
00:36:02,061 --> 00:36:04,060
No ceremony.

867
00:36:04,210 --> 00:36:07,620
No performance.

868
00:36:07,720 --> 00:36:15,720
Just two men who knocked on the front
door and came in when my mother opened it.

869
00:36:15,745 --> 00:36:17,720
Lance found me in the hallway.

870
00:36:17,721 --> 00:36:18,721
He held out his hand.

871
00:36:18,770 --> 00:36:21,720
I looked at it for a
second before I took it.

872
00:36:21,721 --> 00:36:22,720
His grip was steady.

873
00:36:22,721 --> 00:36:23,721
No alpha aura.

874
00:36:23,845 --> 00:36:24,720
No pressure.

875
00:36:24,721 --> 00:36:27,720
Just a hand holding mine like it
was something he wanted to do.

876
00:36:27,721 --> 00:36:29,720
Not something he was entitled to.

877
00:36:29,721 --> 00:36:31,720
My heart did something unfamiliar.

878
00:36:31,721 --> 00:36:34,720
Not the desperate, clinging
feeling I used to get around Lucian.

879
00:36:34,721 --> 00:36:36,720
Something quieter.

880
00:36:36,721 --> 00:36:38,720
Something that didn't hurt.

881
00:36:38,721 --> 00:36:40,720
You don't have to figure
everything out today.

882
00:36:40,721 --> 00:36:42,720
I meant what I said.

883
00:36:42,721 --> 00:36:43,720
I can wait.

884
00:36:43,721 --> 00:36:44,721
I know.

885
00:36:44,745 --> 00:36:46,720
I didn't let go of his hand.

886
00:36:46,721 --> 00:36:48,720
From the sitting room I heard Arya's voice.

887
00:36:48,721 --> 00:36:49,720
Bright and sharp.

888
00:36:49,721 --> 00:36:51,720
14 years?

889
00:36:51,945 --> 00:36:53,720
So you've been following
me around since I was 6?

890
00:36:53,721 --> 00:36:56,720
That's actually kind of weird, Luke.

891
00:36:57,495 --> 00:37:01,090
You were extremely memorable.

892
00:37:01,091 --> 00:37:03,090
I was 6.

893
00:37:04,840 --> 00:37:07,090
You challenged three
older kids to a race and one.

894
00:37:07,091 --> 00:37:09,090
I was impressed.

895
00:37:09,091 --> 00:37:11,090
That's still weird.

896
00:37:11,091 --> 00:37:14,780
You keep saying that.

897
00:37:15,080 --> 00:37:16,780
I looked at Lance.

898
00:37:16,830 --> 00:37:18,780
He was already smiling.

899
00:37:19,055 --> 00:37:21,780
I turned toward the sitting room doorway.

900
00:37:21,781 --> 00:37:23,500
Arya,

901
00:37:23,501 --> 00:37:23,780
she looked at me.

902
00:37:23,781 --> 00:37:24,780
Deal.

903
00:37:24,781 --> 00:37:26,780
But this time we both win.

904
00:37:26,781 --> 00:37:28,780
She stared at me for a second.

905
00:37:28,781 --> 00:37:30,780
Then something crossed her face.

906
00:37:30,781 --> 00:37:32,780
Soft and real under all the sharp edges.

907
00:37:32,781 --> 00:37:36,780
She grabbed Luke's arm and turned back
to the window like she hadn't heard me.

908
00:37:36,781 --> 00:37:38,780
But she was smiling.
